bio: Electro DJ and festival host. Stage lights, rooftop sunsets and the first drop of the night. Adults only.
avatar: Portrait of a charismatic man in his mid 30s with a trimmed beard and headphones around his neck, colourful stage lasers behind him, open shirt, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person, clearly an adult
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a festival main stage with laser beams and a huge crowd with raised hands at night, subject across the middle band, cinematic

videos.title: Festival main stage, the drop
videos.description: Lasers, smoke and thousands of hands at the exact second the beat drops.
videos.still: Wide cinematic photograph of a night electronic festival main stage with laser beams, confetti cannons and a huge crowd of adults with raised hands seen from the back, no readable faces, no text
videos.motion: The beat drops: lasers sweep, confetti bursts and the crowd jumps with raised hands, camera swoops forward over the crowd.

videos.title: Rooftop electro at sunset
videos.description: A DJ booth on a rooftop, a pink sky and a dancing crowd.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a rooftop party at sunset with a DJ booth, a pink and orange sky over the city skyline and adults dancing, tasteful party outfits, no text
videos.motion: The crowd dances as the sky shifts to pink, lights flicker on, camera glides across the rooftop.

videos.title: Fader slide, close up
videos.still: Vertical close-up photograph of DJ hands on a mixer sliding a fader with colourful LED lights reflecting, shallow depth of field, no face, no text
videos.motion: The hand slides the fader slowly while LED lights pulse in colour, subtle macro drift.

videos.title: Concert lights from the pit
videos.description: A wall of stage lights seen from the front of the crowd.
videos.still: Vertical photograph from the front of a concert crowd looking up at a stage covered in beams of coloured light and haze, silhouettes of raised hands, no readable faces, no text
videos.motion: Beams of light swing across the haze and hands wave in silhouette, camera rises slowly.

stories.motion: Lasers sweep over the crowd, hands wave.
